summary: @qlik/embed-runtime preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as 'Types for Qlik Embed libraries' but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`) and uses it to execute `math_init.js`, a ~727KB heavily obfuscated single-line Bun-compiled bundle at the tarball root. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with `_0x...` identifier mangling and indirect-call/object-literal string dispatch. `math_init.js` uses rotated string-array dispatch, hex-mangled identifiers, and carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header. Alternate-runtime execution of a large opaque bundle at install time is inconsistent with a types-only package: types packages ship `.d.ts` declarations and require no runtime, no native binary, and no lifecycle scripts. Pulling Bun to run an obfuscated bundle bypasses Node-based tooling and hides the payload's behavior from review; the code that runs on `npm install` cannot be inspected without deobfuscating the shipped bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
